items.t: Rigetti Falls 5% After CEO Admits Quantum Can’t Yet Prove ROI; IonQ Sinks 8%, D-Wave Slides 5%
items.sum: A quantum CEO just said the quiet part out loud on an earnings call, and the sector's stocks flinched together. The timeline he offered stretches far beyond what growth investors usually tolerate, and a hot inflation print made it hurt more.

items.t: Quantum Stocks Slide as Rigetti, D-Wave Results Disappoint, Nvidia Turmoil Overshadows IonQ
items.sum: Quantum stocks, including Rigetti, D-Wave and IonQ, fell Thursday as Nvidia turmoil and a broader tech selloff overshadowed earnings results.

items.t: Rigetti CEO Admits “None of Us” Can Yet Prove Quantum Beats Classical Computing on ROI
items.sum: Key TakeawaysRigetti’s third-quarter revenue fell to $1. 4 million, far short of analysts’ estimates, and its CEO said no quantum company can yet show a return over classical computing.
